verdict.rationale: Daily's first-party docs say voice AI agents built with its open-source Pipecat framework can be deployed on Daily's global infrastructure, and describe Pipecat as orchestration for realtime voice agents. That supports the core of a server-side realtime voice agent. However, no evidence shows the agent joining a room as a participant, subscribing to live audio tracks, or publishing synthesized speech back. Missing for 10: documentation of the agent joining a session as a participant, documented receipt of live participant audio, documented publishing of speech audio back in realtime, latency details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime

citations.quote: Deploy voice AI agents built with Pipecat on Daily's global infrastructure.
Pipecat is a vendor-neutral open source orchestration framework for realtime voice and multimodal AI agents.
